question: What is the geometric meaning of an eigenvector in PCA?
direct_answer: It is a direction that the covariance matrix stretches or shrinks without rotating.
expanded_answer: For a covariance matrix, an eigenvector is a special axis of the data cloud. After applying the covariance transform, the vector still points in the same direction; only its length changes by the eigenvalue.
common_wrong_ideas: Any direction can be an eigenvector if normalized
